name: Special Meeting Memo
agenda_text:
The City of San Diego
Office of Council President Joe LaCava
First District
M e m o r a n d u m
date: May 19, 2026
to: Honorable City Councilmembers
from: Council President Joe LaCava, District 1
subject: Special Closed Session on May 20, 2026
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________
The City Council will convene for a Special Meeting on Wednesday, May 20, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. or shortly thereafter in City Council Chambers. This Special Council meeting will provide the public with an opportunity to comment on the Special Closed Session agenda in open session prior to the Council convening into Closed Session.
The item to be discussed is the following:
Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation, pursuant to California
Government Code section 54956.9(d)(1):
SCS-1 Mary Brown, et al. v. Joe LaCava, et al.
San Diego Superior Court Case No. 25CU025589C
Risk Management Department Claim File No. 4025
SDCA Assigned: M. Travis Phelps
This case alleges the City’s Solid Waste Management Fee violates Proposition 218. The
City Attorney’s Office will update the Mayor and City Council on the status of the litigation and seek direction.
The Council will then reconvene in open session at the conclusion of Closed Session to discuss the following:
Announcement of Actions Taken in Closed Session.
If you have questions, please contact Luz Anaya Luna, Director of Legislative Affairs, at (619) 235-5880 or lanayaluna@sandiego.gov and Heidi Palmer, Legislative Analyst, at (619) 533-3920 or palmerh@sandiego.gov .
cc: Honorable Mayor Todd Gloria
Honorable City Attorney Heather Ferbert
Charles Modica, Independent Budget Analyst
Diana Fuentes, City Clerk
